scope: Balanced U/B/R/G sample at two raster tiers. Borders only; original text has not been certified, so no typography scores. Frozen baseline template plus accepted shared set scale, then independent translation; uncertain axes retain zero. Raw scores retained. One browser capture per revision, CPU-only comparisons.

scaleProfile.scope: First two U/B/R/G cards per color calibrate one uniform set/frame scale from outer rails; third cards validate. Art-window vertical span is a rejection check, never a fitted scale target. No card-specific scale, rotation, or anisotropic warp. Failed fits retain unit scale. This does not establish physical printing dimensions.
